$comment: Environment variables this brick depends on. Read by `fonderie env`, the admin console and check:env-declarations — docs/ENV-DECLARATIONS-DESIGN.md

vars.name: DATABASE_URL
vars.description: Postgres connection string. On serverless use the pooler URL; migrations take the direct one.

vars.name: EVENTS_INTEGRITY_KEY
vars.description: HMAC key that makes the event and audit log tamper-evident. The same value in every process that publishes.

vars.name: EVENT_RETENTION_DAYS
vars.description: Delete events older than this many days, when you schedule purgeEvents. 365 is the documented default.

vars.name: WORKER_SECRET
vars.description: Bearer token for the worker's health server (runWorker with a port).

worker.description: Long-running event worker with an HTTP health server (runWorker)
